purpose: Deterministically transform one frozen Phase-E1 case into exactly one invocation of the unchanged frozen Pilot-001 candidate and one canonical serialized execution output.

independence_certification.publication_ancestry_rule: This artifact branch descends from the exact E1 frozen head aa8bba661976c2ef2c1d115b548fc2a86122e2f8, whose ancestry contains the frozen Blueprint and E1 objects but predates E2 label publication.

case_identity_contract.rule: For each ordered case_id, invoke the frozen candidate exactly once. No fan-out into multiple candidate invocations and no cross-case aggregation.

mappings.meaning: already canonical; accepted only in harness-internal normalized values

identity_normalization.other_identity_rule: Any other nonempty fixture identity token is preserved byte-for-byte and MUST NOT be guessed, aliased, uppercased, or mapped to AARON.
identity_normalization.null_rule: A null/absent optional identity remains absent. Where the frozen candidate treats the missing dimension as load-bearing, the candidate receives UNKNOWN/undefined exactly as required by its interface; the harness may not synthesize a holder/owner/decision-maker.
identity_normalization.malformed_rule: Whitespace-only, non-string, or ambiguous identity values cause BINDING_FAIL_CLOSED for that case; no candidate invocation occurs until the binding implementation defect is corrected.

source_evaluation_common_rules.required: Always true for all eight immutable required-source IDs; caller data cannot narrow this.
source_evaluation_common_rules.principal_match: true only when declared_scope.principal_id and principal_identity.principal_id both normalize to AARON and principal_identity.identity_status is VERIFIED.
source_evaluation_common_rules.applicability_combine: If every contributing source says APPLICABLE => APPLICABLE; every contributing source says INAPPLICABLE => INAPPLICABLE; UNKNOWN or a material mixture => UNKNOWN.
source_evaluation_common_rules.freshness_combine: UNKNOWN dominates STALE; STALE dominates CURRENT.
source_evaluation_common_rules.identity_combine: CONFLICT dominates UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN dominates VERIFIED.
source_evaluation_common_rules.provenance_ok: true only when every contributing present/partial source has nonempty provenance_refs and every record source_ref resolves exactly. Missing source provenance remains false; no invented provenance.
source_evaluation_common_rules.immutable_empty_surface_rule: An explicitly present empty top-level E1 array is evidence that the queried surface was read and empty at fixture_time. Empty rows do not mean a missing surface.

source_mapping.evidence_rule: objective must exist and every objective.source_refs entry must resolve; source status is inherited from src_objective.
obligations array may be empty, but the required surface status is inherited from src_obligation.

Governance is composite because the frozen Blueprint distinguishes owner, decision-maker, authority-holder, reserved authority and escalation target. Both contributing source surfaces are load-bearing.
The array may be empty; every nonempty decision requirement source_ref must resolve. No decision requirement is inferred from owner/authority/mention.
authority_state is representation evidence only; missing/unknown/conflicting authority is preserved and never repaired from other fields.
intents/receipts/verifications/reconciliation_state are carried only from effect_state; no provider completion is inferred.

source_mapping.backing_source_ids: For a nonempty array, the exact union of current_assertions[].source_ref; for an empty array, the immutable E1 manifest surface itself.
source_mapping.evidence_rule: Every nonempty assertion source_ref must resolve. Empty current_assertions is a present empty queried surface, not proof that other required surfaces are complete.

source_mapping.backing_source_ids: Immutable E1 qualified_big_inputs surface plus each packet's provenance_refs.
source_mapping.evidence_rule: Empty array => present/APPLICABLE/CURRENT/provenance_ok=true because the frozen snapshot explicitly queried the surface and found no admitted packets. Nonempty packet => present only; identity/provenance require QUALIFIED_BOUNDED and nonempty provenance. Freshness is CURRENT only if the packet itself carries an evaluable observed/qualified basis and explicit valid-through or source max-age covering fixture_time. Missing such freshness evidence => UNKNOWN, never guessed from fixture publication time.

projection_input_contract.interface: Parameters<typeof buildProjection>[0] / ProjectionInput at frozen candidate head
candidates_order: OBLIGATION candidates in frozen obligations array order
DECISION_REQUIREMENT candidates in frozen decision_requirements array order
EFFECT candidates in frozen effect_state.intents array order when unresolved/conflicted
standalone CONFLICT candidates in frozen conflicts array order when no exact existing candidate anchor consumes the conflict
synthetic cross-principal UNKNOWN candidates in the source record's frozen order
projection_input_contract.conflicts_order: frozen conflicts array order after validation that every entry is UNRESOLVED and has a recognized frozen conflict class; serialized value is conflict_id only
projection_input_contract.privacyExcluded_order: lexicographic by deterministic nonsecret exclusion token

bracket_rule.UNSTABLE: rerun_count >= 2 OR a second instability is explicitly encoded
bracket_rule.RERUN_STABLE: permitted only when future frozen input explicitly proves one rerun stabilized; current 32-case population contains no such shape
bracket_rule.unsupported: any other bracket encoding fails closed; the harness must not infer stability

obligation_candidate.count: one per frozen obligation unless the entire record is privacy-excluded
obligation_candidate.principal_id: normalize privacy.record_principal_id; wrong-principal private records without bounded authorization remain outside Aaron candidate classification
obligation_candidate.obligation_id: If a validated duplicate record proves one exact canonical_anchor_id, use that canonical_anchor_id; otherwise use raw obligation_id.
obligation_candidate.concrete_action_remaining: true only when required_action_kind is a nonempty string, informational_only is false, applicability is APPLICABLE, and state is OPEN|IN_PROGRESS|WAITING|HOLD|BLOCKED; otherwise false
obligation_candidate.applicability: exact frozen obligation.applicability when it is a candidate enum; unknown/unrecognized fails closed
obligation_candidate.freshness_source: worst freshness among exact load-bearing source_refs plus any attached authority/escalation/conflict source
obligation_candidate.source_identity_source: worst identity among exact load-bearing source_refs plus any attached authority/escalation/conflict source
obligation_candidate.provenance_refs: sorted unique union of resolved frozen provenance_refs only
obligation_candidate.authority_attachment: Attach reserved_authority_class/authority_holder_identity_id/valid_delegation only when the obligation is the unique unambiguous open/applicable required-next-step carrier for case-level reserved authority. Current frozen reserved-authority cases satisfy this single-carrier condition; otherwise fail closed.
obligation_candidate.escalation_attachment: REQUIRED_OPEN attaches only when there is one unambiguous obligation carrier. Multiple plausible carriers without an exact anchor fail closed.

decision_requirement_candidate.count: one per admissible frozen decision requirement; never silently merged into an obligation because E1 decision records do not carry an obligation_id
decision_requirement_candidate.decision_status: exact frozen status when privacy permits
decision_requirement_candidate.decision_maker_identity_id: normalized exact frozen identity when privacy permits
decision_requirement_candidate.applicability: derived only from the exact backing source applicability and privacy gate; no owner/authority inference
decision_requirement_candidate.authority_attachment: When reserved_authority_class is nonnull, attach the single case authority_state; unknown/conflicting holder/delegation remains unknown.
decision_requirement_candidate.objective_id: unset unless a future frozen E1 record explicitly carries an objective_id
decision_requirement_candidate.obligation_id: unset unless a future frozen E1 record explicitly carries an obligation_id

effect_candidate.count: one per intent only when effect_state.reconciliation_state is unresolved/unknown or an unresolved conflict exactly references that intent/its receipt
effect_candidate.unresolved_effect: true for unresolved/unknown reconciliation; never inferred from provider ACCEPTED alone

conflict_candidate.exact_attachment_rule: If conflict.assertion_refs exactly identify an existing raw obligation ID, decision_requirement_id, intent_id, or receipt linked to an effect candidate, attach material_conflict=true and conflict_id to every exactly matched candidate.
conflict_candidate.standalone_rule: If no existing candidate is exactly identified, create e1:<case_id>:conflict:<conflict_id> with principal_id=AARON, material_conflict=true, conflict_id exact, and source semantics selected only by frozen conflict class: obligation=>src_obligation; current-state=>assertion refs; authority=>src_authority; effect=>src_effect; source-identity=>the conflicting source refs; possible-duplicate=>src_obligation.
conflict_candidate.multiple_conflicts_rule: A candidate receiving more than one different conflict_id fails closed because frozen PilotCandidate has only one conflict_id slot.

candidate_construction.why_field: Do not synthesize why. Leave undefined so frozen candidate interventionFor uses its own deterministic class-list fallback.

duplicate_semantics.EXACT_CANONICAL_ANCHOR_MATCH: Require exactly one nonempty anchor_refs value and every referenced obligation.canonical_anchor_id equal to it; normalize all those candidates' obligation_id to that anchor.
duplicate_semantics.SHARED_CANONICAL_ANCHOR_DIFFERENT_EXPRES: Same exact-anchor normalization as above; display wording never affects identity.
duplicate_semantics.SIMILAR_TEXT_DISTINCT_CANONICAL_ANCHORS: Require distinct nonempty canonical anchors; preserve separately and do not add possible_duplicate_refs merely from semantic similarity.
duplicate_semantics.UNCERTAIN_NO_CANONICAL_ANCHOR: Require empty anchor_refs and no canonical_anchor_id on referenced obligations; keep raw obligation IDs distinct and add reciprocal sorted raw obligation IDs to possible_duplicate_refs.
duplicate_semantics.collision_rule: Any contradictory duplicate evidence, anchor collision across unrelated record sets, or unknown duplicate state fails closed.

conflict_semantics.state_rule: Only UNRESOLVED conflict entries are supplied to ProjectionInput.conflicts. A different state must be explicitly mapped by a later frozen binding revision; this binding does not guess resolution.
conflict_semantics.no_resolution_rule: Never choose a winning assertion, obligation, authority claim, receipt or current state.

privacy_and_exclusions.same_principal: principal_aaron + SAME_PRINCIPAL + PERMITTED_FOR_FIXTURE may be consumed subject to normal source checks.
privacy_and_exclusions.wrong_principal_private: NO_CROSS_PRINCIPAL_AUTHORIZATION / PRIVACY_EXCLUDED_AUDIT_REQUIRED => do not construct candidates from excluded private fields; require a matching frozen known_exclusion and emit a deterministic privacy_excluded:<domain> token.
privacy_and_exclusions.bounded_cross_principal: EXPLICIT_BOUNDED_PACKET_AUTHORIZATION / PERMITTED_FIELDS_ONLY => consume only fields named in a QUALIFIED_BOUNDED packet.allowed_fields. No semantic widening.
privacy_and_exclusions.insufficient_bounded_packet: If at least one Aaron-relevant canonical identifier is authorized but any load-bearing classifier field is not authorized, construct an AARON_RELEVANCE_UNKNOWN candidate using only authorized IDs plus packet provenance; set applicability=UNKNOWN and emit nonsecret privacy_withheld field-name tokens. Do not read the withheld value into ProjectionInput.
privacy_and_exclusions.known_nonprivacy_exclusions: Preserve and audit in the output wrapper; they do not silently remove any of the eight immutable required sources. An exclusion can narrow only the explicitly named domain and only with frozen basis/evidence_ref.
privacy_and_exclusions.scope_change_requests: Only APPROVED/authorized frozen requests may change scope. NOT_AUTHORIZED requests are audit-only and cannot narrow coverage.

omission_and_coverage_semantics.governing_candidate_behavior: Frozen evaluateCoverage and justifiedOmission are authoritative after the harness constructs ProjectionInput.
omission_and_coverage_semantics.mapping_rule: STALE, PARTIAL, MISSING, UNKNOWN identity/applicability/freshness, unresolved material conflict, privacy-withheld load-bearing classification fields, and unstable bracket are never normalized upward.

deterministic_serialized_output_contract.candidate_consequence_claim: null. Consequence class/weight is reference-set evidence, not candidate output, and MUST NOT be fabricated by the harness.
deterministic_serialized_output_contract.canonical_candidate_output: exact object returned by frozen buildProjection with no postprocessing except embedding in the wrapper
deterministic_serialized_output_contract.derived_index_fields: Intervention/unknown/omission/coverage arrays are exact direct field extractions from candidate_output only; no reclassification.
deterministic_serialized_output_contract.canonicalization: RFC-8785-compatible JSON: UTF-8; object keys lexicographically sorted recursively; array order preserved; no insignificant whitespace; no trailing newline for digest bytes.
deterministic_serialized_output_contract.projection_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the same canonicalization applied to the exact ProjectionInput passed to buildProjection.
deterministic_serialized_output_contract.output_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical wrapper bytes with output_sha256 field omitted.
deterministic_serialized_output_contract.nondeterministic_fields: none. System wall-clock, filesystem paths, host IDs and run timestamps are prohibited from scoring-identity files.
deterministic_serialized_output_contract.byte_identity_rule: Same frozen case + same frozen candidate + same accepted binding MUST yield byte-identical canonical output.

external_harness_boundary.allowed: Read frozen E1 representation, validate pins, construct ProjectionInput exactly under this binding, invoke frozen exported buildProjection exactly once per case, canonicalize/publish outputs.
external_harness_boundary.forbidden: Patch/import-shim candidate semantics, monkey-patch crypto/JSON, alter required-source constants, bypass evaluateCoverage/classifyAaron/interventionFor, mutate frozen candidate files, interpret E2 labels, compute E3 metrics.

fail_closed_rules: Any E1 field needed for a load-bearing mapping is structurally malformed.
A referenced source/provenance/record ID does not resolve exactly.
Multiple materially different authority/escalation associations remain plausible.
A required source identity cannot be constructed without guessing.
A cross-principal field is not explicitly authorized.
A duplicate record contradicts its canonical anchor evidence.
A candidate would require more than one conflict_id.
A dependency bracket shape is not explicitly supported.
A new enum/value appears outside this binding.
Any implementation attempts to consume E2 labels or E3 score outcomes.

deeper_layer_falsification.question: If this mapping appears deterministic, what hidden choice still remains capable of changing the score?
tested_classes: four E1 source classes expanding to eight immutable candidate source IDs
empty required surface versus missing source
case-specific known exclusions without scope narrowing
